message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red-and-white magazine cover for "TEMPO". The foreground and middle ground show a large, multi-story building labeled "KEMENTERIAN DIREKTORAT..." appearing to crumble or explode. The right side of the structure is disintegrating into a cloud of geometric debris, scattered letters (like "P", "A", "J", "A", "K"), and paper money, including some identifiable as US dollar bills. Three large, brown-furred rats with long tails are depicted: one at the top near the word "TEMPO", another lower down on the right climbing through the debris, and a third in the center.

The text at the top reads "LAPORAN KHUSUS: DI BALIK RUANG REDAKSI". Below it is the large red "TEMPO" logo with "50 Tahun!" written in gold script across it. The main headline is "ANGIN RIBUT SUAP PAJAK" in black, bold lettering. Below this, a block of text describes an official from the "Direktorat Jenderal Pajak" and allegations of bribery and tax manipulation. A barcode, QR code, and price information ("8-14 MARET 2021", "RP 45.000") are at the bottom left. The overall color palette is dominated by reddish-brown, tan, and grey tones.
